title: Opening Night at the Aurora Orbital Hotel
resultLines: The VIPs are in cargo, the Spa is dark and the soufflé is raw. Same time next week?
One out of three. The guests will mostly remember the free drinks.
Two out of three! The reviews call it "mostly not on fire".
Flawless! Five stars from the Duchess — the hotel names a cocktail after your crew.

rounds.title: The VIP Shuttle
rounds.question: Which gate do we open for the VIP shuttle?

answers.label: Gate A
answers.narration: Gate A vents! The VIPs arrive windswept, furious and slightly blue.

answers.label: Gate B
answers.narration: The VIPs are delivered to the cargo hold, between two crates of napkins.

answers.label: Gate C
answers.narration: A buttery-smooth docking. The VIPs glide into the ballroom to applause.

clues: Gate A reaches the ballroom on the BLUE route.
Gate C reaches the ballroom on the YELLOW route. Gate B only goes to cargo.
Status board: Gate A ◇, Gate C ◇.
◇ means safe, but blue routes flip meaning after an overload.
The blue routes overloaded four minutes ago.
rounds.timeout: Nobody opened a gate. The shuttle circles until a tug drags it in by the bumper.

rounds.title: The Power Reroute
rounds.question: Which deck gets the extra power for the opening toast?

answers.label: The Observatory
answers.narration: The great telescope glows magnificently for an audience of zero. The toast happens in the dark.

answers.label: The Kitchens
answers.narration: The banquet hall blazes with light. The robot chef raises a spatula in salute.

answers.label: The Spa
answers.narration: The breaker blows. The Spa goes dark mid-facial and the steam room becomes a fog machine.

clues: Line 1 feeds the Observatory. Line 2 feeds the Kitchens. Line 3 feeds the Spa.
▼ means a line is maxed out — add any more power and its breaker blows.
The power is for the opening toast. It's wasted on a deck with no guests on it.
Tonight's schedule: the Observatory is closed until midnight for telescope polishing.
rounds.timeout: Nobody flipped the switch. The toast is made by candlelight, which is a fire hazard in space.

rounds.title: The Literal Robot Chef
rounds.question: Which dish card do we feed the robot chef for the first course?

answers.label: Soufflé
answers.narration: A perfectly risen, piping-hot soufflé. The chef bows. The Duchess weeps.

answers.label: Sorbet
answers.narration: The guests receive a frozen first course and some very cold looks.

answers.label: Flambé
answers.narration: The grill erupts. With no sprinkler, the banquet moves to the corridor.

clues: Dish cards: Soufflé = Oven ♨ ⟳. Sorbet = Freezer ❄ ⟳. Flambé = Grill ♨ ♨ ♨.
Card glyphs: ♨ means HEAT, ❄ means CHILL, ⟳ means repeat the step before it.
Banquet etiquette: the first course must be served WARM.
Safety log: the Grill sprinkler is off tonight. Any heat on the Grill starts a fire.
Chef's manual: a soufflé needs at least TWO heat steps, or it comes out raw.
rounds.timeout: The chef waits patiently for a card. So do two hundred hungry guests.
